theorem_summary.name: canonical_syntactic_cone_normalizer
theorem_summary.measured_object: union of formula-label inputs reachable from variables in the final CNF
theorem_summary.consequence: support-local normalization follows when final syntactic-cone support is bounded

proof_skeleton: define canonical singleton cones for formula-label variables
define each extension-variable cone as the union of input cones in the acyclic definition graph
observe that canonical cones form a valid dependency-cone annotation
apply the dependency-cone extension normalizer theorem
inherit polarity lower bounds and support-local normalization budget
